sites.provider: openai/gpt-4o-mini via Vercel AI SDK generateObject
sites.reason: Closed 5-label genre classification over a fixed, trusted prompt. No prose generation, no reasoning, no multi-hop logic, no adversarial input. Textbook Choice primitive match.

options.benefit: Jev Choice is purpose-built for closed-set selection; expected lower latency and cost for accepted decisions. Conservative fallback retains original path for low confidence, errors, timeouts, and rate limits.
options.risk: Low — serial miss adds Jev latency before original inference. Diagnostics (usage, finishReason) adapted to reflect actual answering path.
options.scope: Convert generateObject call to Jev Choice with confidence gate; retain original generateObject as fallback. Log answer path and model version.
The site works today; Jev adds complexity for a single hardcoded classification.
